[Sweet Corn]: Lasts for the entire battle. Cannot be dispelled. Can stack up to 5 times.

The Phantasm holder accumulates DMG dealt and DMG received by themselves. When accumulated DMG dealt reaches 200% of own ATK or accumulated DMG received reaches 20% of own Max HP, clears the corresponding accumulated value and triggers the [Have a Bite] effect.

[Have a Bite]
Consumes 1 stack of [Sweet Corn] to restore HP equal to 10% of the Phantasm holder's Max HP (unaffected by healing increase, reduction, or conversion modification effects), and gains {0} Fury and 1 stack of [Hyped Up!].

[Hyped Up!]
The next time the holder performs a Normal Attack, casts a Skill or ULT/Mega ULT, or performs a Follow-Up Attack or Counterattack, consumes 1 stack of [Hyped Up!] to increase the bearer's DMG Bonus by 50%, ULT DMG Bonus by 50%, and Skill DMG Bonus by 50%. Lasts for the entire battle, cannot be dispelled, and stacks up to 10 times.
